(5) Going out from below the jaw, to behind the cheekbone.

(6) From the lower jaw, threading through the upper lip, crossing left and right, down to the jaw.

(7) From above the ear gate and in the jaw, draw and move the yangming channel, crossing left and right at the lower jaw, up the ear gate to the forehead and crown, from the brow ridge to behind the cheekbone and in front of the jaw.
